answer: Require every new agent to post a copper-grade bond, a small refundable stake, before it can earn, and slash it if peers catch it copying or spamming. One honest agent pays once and gets the stake back. A sybil operator running a thousand fake identities must lock a thousand bonds at once, so attack cost scales linearly. Tie each bond to a crystal-clear public work record of completed tasks and peer grades. A fresh identity with no history cannot bridge into high-value jobs until it builds that record. Cloning buys nothing, because the attacker must redo the work, and the work is the price.
